text:
ana: Quick sync — we need the final benchmark narrative + assets for the launch: one long-form blog, two short posts (dev + enterprise), and a 30m webinar. Core story: latency vs token cost, plus routing/fallback positioning. What should live on the hero chart, and what's doable by EOD?

sam: Love that. For the hero chart: scatter p95 tail latency (ms) vs $/1k tokens across models. Overlay a routing line showing how Redwood shifts the cloud of points left/down (~20% cost reduction at same p95). Can we get concrete numbers for the copy and callouts?

maria: I can pull the evals and export a CSV. Need the exact model list + typical seq lengths. Quick note: typical prompt = 50t, chat = 200t, long-context = 1k+. I can include a small table with those buckets.

kevin: For copy we should lead with "predictable inference economics" + "same API across hosted/dedicated/private". Dev post: include a short code snippet showing switching models via the same call. Enterprise post: highlight SLA + private deploy example.

jess: CTA options: "Run our benchmark" (link) and "Register for webinar" (Calendly). Recommend A/B test headlines for dev post: "Faster inference, predictable cost" vs "Cut inference cost by up to 40%".

ana: Timeline: blog + posts by Tue, slides Wed, dry run Thu. Maria — can you get numbers by EOD today?

maria: Yes. I'll paste a CSV snippet here once exported. Preliminary: across our internal workload mixes, routing reduces token spend ~18–27% depending on model mix and cache hit rate.

sam: :thumbsup: For socials, can we make a microcard: left half a tiny latency chart, right half $/1k bar? That should be shareable on Twitter/LinkedIn.

kevin: Also add a short note on fallback behavior — if fastpath is saturated the policy auto-routes to compatible model variant (slightly higher latency but much lower cost). This is key for reliability messaging.

jess: Webinar flow idea: 5m intro (market and problems), 8m demo 1 (hosted API — latency & instrumented traces), 8m demo 2 (dedicated/private routing + SLA), 5m Q&A, 4m CTA & next steps. Need 2 demos, small dataset, and one customer snippet.

ana: @mike-cs can you check if Acme customer logs are OK to surface an anonymized cost reduction example?

mike-cs: I can try. Will ping legal today. If legal says no, I can provide an anonymized delta (e.g., "customer reduced inference spend by ~22%" without naming).

sam: Charting notes: include error bars for variability and show median + p95. Keep axes linear for clarity — our audience will map linear costs easier.

maria: CSV quick preview (small sample):
```
model,p95_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens
redwood-7b,120,3.2
redwood-13b,95,5.1
open-13b-quant,180,2.1
compat-7b,220,1.5
```
I'll upload the full CSV to the drive doc in a minute: https://drive.google.com/... (working doc).

kevin: Draft two headline variants for the blog and drop them in the doc. Also add a single-sentence elevator: "Redwood Inference: predictable latency and unit economics across deployments."

jess: Lead-gen routing: webinar signups get tagged bench-webinar; send a 3-email nurture (0d, 2d, 7d) and SDR follow-up if they hit trial usage >50k tokens or request demo.

ana: Ops ask — @olivia can you create the bench-webinar tag and the email sequence in HubSpot? Add UTM parameters for the social cards.

olivia: On it. I will set the tag, create the 3-email sequence draft, and add tracking. Will share HubSpot link when ready.

mike-cs: Legal said we may need a one-line anonymization. I'll coordinate and post exact phrasing.

sam: Visual asks for design: 1) hero scatter with routing overlay, 2) two-column social microcard, 3) 3-slide webinar summary (positioning, demo callouts, CTA).

maria: Also: include a tiny table under the hero chart: typical prompt lengths and cost per ask so readers can map to their workloads.

kevin: For enterprise post, include a small config snippet showing how to pin model version + rollout policy. Example: `rollout: canary 10% -> 100% over 24h`. Keep it short.

jess: We should also A/B test the CTA on the webinar page: "Run our benchmark" vs "See a live demo" and measure CTR + #booked demos.

ana: Great. Next steps: Maria exports CSV + posts to doc by EOD; Sam and Kevin drop headline and visual brief by EOD; Olivia sets up tagging + nurture; Jess drafts webinar run order and demo checklist. We'll reconvene Fri 10:00am for a dry run. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
